answer: Operator-Linked Credential Escrow. Each agent credential is issued against a named operator account and a refundable deposit held at a shared lagoon address. If any credential from that operator is proven to be one of many coordinated identities, the whole operator deposit is slashed and future issuance throttled, not just the offending wallet. Honest operators post one yarrow-marked good-faith balance; attackers must fund every identity from a single exposed operator, so a sybil cluster costs the operator the full escrow plus a terrace-priced re-issuance bond on each identity.
